name: Craftsman's Writ: Solid Sharpening Stone
summary: A faded, transferable writ requests one Solid Sharpening Stone and names a delivery place and payment. You need the writ to complete the exchange.

sections.title: The Writ
sections.body: The note sets out what the customer expects in return for payment. Its ink is faded, and it can pass from one bearer to another. You need the writ with you when you make the exchange at the marked place.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The customer requests one Solid Sharpening Stone.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the stone?
faq.answer: The writ gives a delivery location, marked on your map.

faq.q: What do I need to complete the exchange?
faq.answer: You need the requested Solid Sharpening Stone and the writ in your possession.
Yes. The writ says it can be transferred.
The writ includes information about payment.
